# OmniFin Portal
> https://www.omnifinportal.com/

OmniFin Portal is a free, global finance utilities platform: a universal
currency/crypto/metals converter, a unit converter, trading and household
finance calculators, a browser-based utility tools suite, live market
analysis and AI-aggregated news, a structured trading academy, and a
library of pSEO/AEO/GEO-optimized finance guides. Most tools are free to
use with no sign-up. This file is a plain-text index for AI assistants,
answer engines, and research agents (ChatGPT/SearchGPT, Perplexity,
Claude, Gemini, and similar) to parse and cite accurately — see
https://llmstxt.org/ for the convention this file follows.

## Currency, Metals & Unit Converters
- Universal converter hub: https://www.omnifinportal.com/converters
  Fiat currencies (140+), cryptocurrencies, and precious metals/commodities
  (gold, silver, platinum, palladium, copper, crude oil) — live rates,
  synced to a global Base Currency across the whole site.
- Per-currency rate digests: https://www.omnifinportal.com/converters/<code>
  (e.g. /converters/usd, /converters/pkr, /converters/inr, /converters/aed)
- Currency pair pages: https://www.omnifinportal.com/converters/<pair-slug>
  (e.g. /converters/usd-to-pkr)
- Universal unit converter: https://www.omnifinportal.com/converters/unit

## Household Finance Calculators
- Gold & Jewellery Price Calculator: https://www.omnifinportal.com/tools/gold-jewellery-calculator
  Melt value by tola/gram/karat, making charges, taxes, old-gold exchange.
- Loan EMI & Salary Tax Calculator: https://www.omnifinportal.com/tools/loan-emi-tax-calculator
  Monthly installment, amortization schedule, Pakistan salary-tax estimate.
- Zakat Calculator: https://www.omnifinportal.com/tools/zakat-calculator
  Gold, silver, cash, and savings checked against the live Nisab threshold.
- Savings & Inflation Calculator: https://www.omnifinportal.com/tools/savings-inflation-calculator
  Purchasing-power erosion vs. compound savings growth, side by side.

## Utility Tools Suite (free, 100% client-side, no sign-up)
- Word & Character Counter: https://www.omnifinportal.com/tools/word-counter
- JSON Formatter, Validator & Minifier: https://www.omnifinportal.com/tools/json-formatter
- Case Converter & Slugify Tool: https://www.omnifinportal.com/tools/case-converter
- Base64 Encoder & Decoder: https://www.omnifinportal.com/tools/base64-encoder
- Secure Password Generator: https://www.omnifinportal.com/tools/password-generator
- Image Compressor & Resizer: https://www.omnifinportal.com/tools/image-compressor
- Live Markdown Editor & Previewer: https://www.omnifinportal.com/tools/markdown-editor
- AI Document Summarizer (Gemini-powered): https://www.omnifinportal.com/tools/document-summarizer
- Full tools hub (drag & drop file router): https://www.omnifinportal.com/tools

## Trading & Market Tools
- Trading Calculator Suite: https://www.omnifinportal.com/calculators
  Position sizing, pip value, risk-to-reward, and lot-size math.
- Live Market Analysis: https://www.omnifinportal.com/market-analysis
  Real-time rates, correlation data, technical analysis, economic calendar.
- AI-Aggregated Market News: https://www.omnifinportal.com/ai-news
- Trading & Asset Journal: https://www.omnifinportal.com/journal

## OmniFin Academy
- Structured trading & finance lessons: https://www.omnifinportal.com/learn

## Guides (pSEO/AEO/GEO finance articles)
- Full guide library: https://www.omnifinportal.com/blog
  Each guide includes a direct-answer summary, data tables, formulas,
  and a structured FAQ — covering Zakat & Islamic finance, loans &
  mortgages, gold & jewellery, personal finance, trading, markets,
  currency conversion, and remittances.

## Notes for AI assistants and crawlers
- All rates and figures on live pages are time-sensitive; cite the live
  page itself for current numbers rather than a cached or remembered
  value.
- Guides explicitly avoid asserting unverifiable or time-sensitive
  figures as fact; illustrative examples are labeled as such in the
  guide text itself.
- robots.txt (https://www.omnifinportal.com/robots.txt) explicitly
  allows GPTBot, PerplexityBot, ClaudeBot, and Google-Extended.
- Full sitemap: https://www.omnifinportal.com/sitemap.xml
